method: Read-only Ninja query for the 21 configured link nodes. Explicit linker object inputs are separated from implicit and order-only object dependencies. Exact primary compile inputs are read from matching build.ninja compile edges. Retained ninja -t deps records are streamed and selected only for explicit link object inputs. No configure, compile, or relink was run.
scopeLimit: This read-only closure covers explicit object link inputs and available depfile records in the retained build tree. Missing depfiles are retained and enumerated; no transitive closure is claimed for them. This is not a clean recipient build, complete generator/tool execution trace, legal applicability decision, complete corresponding-source offer, or recipient relink. Xcode SDK/toolchain inputs remain external machine requirements. Per-link-node object-to-primary-source mappings are included so image rows can be joined to the configured compile inputs; recursive static archive dependencies are listed per node and must be followed when deriving an image-wide source set. The 105 explicit Swift object nodes without ordinary depfiles have a separate exact Ninja-declared file/module graph receipt; compiler implicit imports and tool execution closure remain open.
